$comment: Declares what the renderer emits and under what conditions. Inclusion is decided HERE rather than inside templates, so a template file stays valid HCL/YAML/Markdown on its own and factory CI can run `terraform fmt -check` and `terraform validate` against the raw corpus. Conditions use the same tiny expression grammar as the #{{IF}} directives: path, !path, path == 'v', path != 'v', path contains 'v', joined by && and ||.
$statusComment: Stage 5 delivers the rendering ENGINE. The entries below are the proof set that exercises every engine feature end to end: plain tokens, typed tokens, conditionals, loops, per-layer expansion, and verbatim copy. Stages 6-8 grow this manifest to the full corpus by promoting terraform/ and .github/workflows/ into factory/templates/.

files.description: Landing zone repository README, self-documenting from the configuration.
Global layer variables: org prefix, subscriptions, allowed locations.
Variable declarations. Copied verbatim — this file is the contract the schema-drift check validates against, so it must never be templated.
Connectivity layer variables. Omitted entirely when no platform networking is deployed.
Pull-request plan workflow. Uses the read-only plan identity.
Identity trust matrix, generated from the environment list so it cannot drift from what the broker actually creates.

perLayerFiles.description: Backend configuration, rendered once per active layer. Each layer keeps an isolated state file — layers are never merged (control AR3).
